primary.title: Mein Kampf
primary.author: Adolf Hitler
primary.rationale: Hitler's autobiographical manifesto, outlining his political ideology and future plans for Germany. It is a foundational text for understanding his worldview.

primary.title: Hitler's Table Talk
primary.author: Adolf Hitler
primary.rationale: Transcripts of Hitler's monologues and conversations recorded during World War II. Offers insights into his thoughts and opinions on various subjects.

primary.title: Speeches of Adolf Hitler, 1922-1945
primary.author: Adolf Hitler
primary.rationale: A collection of Hitler's public addresses, which were crucial for his rise to power and propaganda efforts. These speeches reveal his rhetorical style and political messaging.

secondary.title: Hitler: A Biography
secondary.author: Ian Kershaw
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and highly regarded two-volume biography of Hitler, considered a definitive scholarly work on his life and regime.

secondary.title: The Third Reich: A New History
secondary.author: Richard J. Evans
secondary.rationale: The first volume of a major scholarly trilogy on Nazi Germany, providing extensive historical context and analysis of Hitler's rise and rule.

secondary.title: Hitler's Willing Executioners: Ordinary Germans and the Holocaust
secondary.author: Daniel Goldhagen
secondary.rationale: A controversial but influential work that examines the role of ordinary Germans in the Holocaust, offering a perspective on the societal context of Hitler's regime.

suggestions.notes: Primary source availability on Wikisource and Project Gutenberg may be limited due to copyright and content policies. Internet Archive is a more likely repository for these historical texts.
